name: Green Hygienics, Inc.
summary: Green Hygienics Inc. specializes in the creation and distribution of various absorbent paper items made from bamboo. Their extensive product lineup features diapers, sanitary pads, panty liners, baby wipes, toilet paper, facial tissues, kitchen paper towels, pulp-based plates and cups, feminine wipes, cosmetic wipes and pads, and sweat pads. Formerly known as MNI Nutraceuticals, Inc., the company officially rebranded as Green Hygienics Inc. on May 20, 2011. Headquartered in Reno, Nevada, Green Hygienics Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Green Innovations Ltd.
